name: CME Crypto Futures Basis Analysis
description: Research study analyzing the CME futures-spot basis for Bitcoin (BT) and Ethereum (ER) futures vs their spot prices (BTCUSD, ETHUSD). Computes daily basis (futures premium/discount as % of spot), annualized implied carry, and cumulative basis carry. Outputs: cross-sectional summary table with avg/current/max/min basis and % of days in premium; per-asset basis time series; basis distribution histogram; cumulative basis carry chart.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CME CRYPTO FUTURES BASIS ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Compares CME Bitcoin (BT) and Ethereum (ER) quarterly futures prices against
# spot (BTCUSD, ETHUSD) to derive:
#   - Daily basis = (futures close - spot close) / spot close
#   - Annualized implied carry = basis * (365 / ~45 avg days to expiry)
#   - Cumulative basis (running sum of daily basis as proxy for carry cost)
#
# Uses NoAdjustment on futures continuation to preserve actual price levels
# for meaningful basis calculation (see cross_commodity_ratio_adjustment pitfall).
# =============================================================================

# --- Spot Data (from study universe) ---
src = market_data_source()()
spot_close = src.c

# --- CME Bitcoin Futures (reference data) ---
bt_ref = reference_futures(ticker="BT")()
bt_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(bt_ref.o, bt_ref.h, bt_ref.l, bt_ref.c, bt_ref.v, bt_ref.oi, bt_ref.s)
bt_fut_close = bt_cont.c

# --- CME Ethereum Futures (reference data) ---
er_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ER")()
er_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(er_ref.o, er_ref.h, er_ref.l, er_ref.c, er_ref.v, er_ref.oi, er_ref.s)
er_fut_close = er_cont.c

# --- Match futures to spot per asset ---
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="BTCUSD")()
is_eth = is_asset_ref(ticker="ETHUSD")()

# Select the correct futures close for each asset in the universe
fut_close = conditional_select(is_btc, bt_fut_close, is_eth, er_fut_close, 0.0 / 0.0)

# --- Basis Calculation ---
# Basis = (futures - spot) / spot, expressed as decimal fraction
basis = (fut_close - spot_close) / spot_close

# Annualized implied carry: basis scaled by approximate annualization factor
# CME crypto futures are quarterly (~45 days avg to next expiry)
annualized_carry = basis * (365.0 / 45.0)

# Rolling 30-day average basis for smoothed view
basis_ma30 = ma(period=30)(basis)

# Cumulative basis: running sum of daily basis as proxy for carry income/cost
cum_basis = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(basis)

# --- Metrics for Summary Table ---
# Basis in basis points for readability
basis_bps = basis * 10000.0

# Boolean: is basis positive (futures premium)?
basis_positive = basis > 0

# Pre-compute expanding metrics so cs_summary_table can use agg=Last
avg_ann_carry = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(annualized_carry)
current_basis_bps = basis_bps
max_basis_bps = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(basis_bps)
min_basis_bps = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(basis_bps)
pct_days_premium = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(basis_positive)
avg_basis_bps = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(basis_bps)

# --- Cross-Sectional Summary Table ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='CME Futures Basis Summary',
    category='1. Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='CME Futures Basis Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ann. Carry', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Basis (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Basis (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min Basis (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='% Days in Premium', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Basis (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(avg_ann_carry, current_basis_bps, max_basis_bps, min_basis_bps, pct_days_premium, avg_basis_bps)

# --- Chart 1: Basis Over Time ---
bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Futures-Spot Basis Over Time',
    category='2. Basis Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Basis (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Daily Basis', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='30d Moving Avg', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, basis, basis_ma30)

# --- Chart 2: Distribution of Basis ---
histogram(
    title='Basis Distribution',
    category='2. Basis Analysis',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Basis (bps)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=2
)(basis_bps)

# --- Chart 3: Cumulative Basis Carry ---
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Basis Carry (Running Sum)',
    category='3. Cumulative Carry',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Basis',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Basis', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, cum_basis)
